# Roadmap

The project roadmap lives in [`docs/roadmap.md`](../docs/roadmap.md) and is also published on the
documentation site. It maps every `epic/*` label to a release phase:

1. **Phase 1 — v0.2 Hardening**
2. **Phase 2 — v1.0 Production Readiness**
3. **Phase 3 — Post-1.0 Scale**

Progress is tracked on the
[GitHub Project board](https://github.com/orgs/Automated-Cross-Contract-SDK/projects).
Roadmap updates are posted in
[Discussions → Announcements](https://github.com/Automated-Cross-Contract-SDK/Automated-Cross-Contract-SDK-Frontend-/discussions/categories/announcements).
